violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: 3DR UPR McCall fridge was temping at 55 degrees at time of inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT ALL REFRIGERATION UNITS MUST BE MAINTAINED AT A TEMP 41F OR BELOW. PIC CALLED IN A SERVICE ORDER FOR THE FRIDGE BEFORE THE END OF THE INSPECTION. SOMEONE WILL COME TAKE A LOOK AT THE FRIDGE TODAY. PIC HAD EMPLOYEES THROW AWAY FOODS THAT WERE NOT TEMPING CORRECTLY AND PUT OTHER FOODS IN THE WALK-IN TO COOL BACK TO 41.
